abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address points to a different Jellyfin server.

abort.quick_connect_disabled: Quick Connect is disabled on this server. Enable it in the Jellyfin dashboard or sign in with a password.

user.title: Jellyfin server
user.description: Enter the address of your Jellyfin server.

data_description.url: For example http://192.168.1.10:8096. A /jellyfin base path behind a reverse proxy is detected automatically.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server using a self-signed certificate.

auth.title: Sign in to {server}
auth.description: Choose how Home Assistant signs in. Only an access token is stored; the password is never kept.

data_description.username: Use an administrator to control every client and scan libraries.
data_description.password: Exchanged once for an access token, then discarded.

quick_connect.title: Quick Connect
quick_connect.description: In a Jellyfin app already signed in to {server}, open Settings > Quick Connect and enter the code **{code}**. Then submit this form.

data_description.url: New address of the same Jellyfin server.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server using a self-signed certificate.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the sessions are read from the server.
data_description.audio_codec: Codec used when music from the library is streamed to another Home Assistant player.

invalid_auth.message: The Jellyfin access token was refused. Sign in again.

forbidden.message: This Jellyfin user is not allowed to do that (administrator rights are required).

not_found.message: The Jellyfin item was not found.

session_unavailable.message: The Jellyfin client is not connected.

command_unsupported.message: The Jellyfin client does not support the {command} command.

unsupported_media_source.message: Jellyfin clients can only play items of their own library, not {media_id}.

play_media_shuffle.name: Play media shuffled
play_media_shuffle.description: Plays an item or folder shuffled, replacing the queue.

play_items.name: Play items
play_items.description: Plays or queues library items; folders, series, albums and playlists are expanded.

item_ids.name: Item IDs
item_ids.description: Jellyfin item IDs, played in this order.

enqueue.name: Enqueue
enqueue.description: Play now or add to the queue.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Shuffle the items before sending them.

start_index.name: Start index
start_index.description: Position in the list to start from.

start_position.name: Start position
start_position.description: Where to start in the first item.

play_instant_mix.name: Play instant mix
play_instant_mix.description: Plays a mix the server builds from a song, album, artist or genre.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: Song, album, artist or genre to start from.

seek_relative.name: Seek relative
seek_relative.description: Moves forward or backward from the current position.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Positive to move forward, negative to move back.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Shows a message on the client screen.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long the message stays visible.

send_text.name: Send text
send_text.description: Types text into the focused field of the client (search box).

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends any Jellyfin general command with arguments.

command.name: Command
command.description: General command name, for example ToggleOsdMenu or SetVolume.

display_content.name: Display content
display_content.description: Opens the page of an item on the client.

set_audio_stream.name: Set audio track
set_audio_stream.description: Switches the audio track of the playing item.

index.name: Stream index
index.description: Jellyfin index of the audio stream.

set_subtitle_stream.name: Set subtitles
set_subtitle_stream.description: Switches the subtitles of the playing item.

index.name: Stream index
index.description: Jellyfin index of the subtitle stream, -1 to turn subtitles off.

set_user_data.name: Set played or favorite
set_user_data.description: Marks an item played or unplayed, favorite or not.

favorite.name: Favorite
favorite.description: Add to (on) or remove from (off) favorites.

get_queue.name: Get queue
get_queue.description: Returns the play queue of the client.

browse_library.name: Browse library
browse_library.description: Returns the children of a library folder.

parent_id.name: Parent ID
parent_id.description: Folder, series, album or special:resume, special:next_up, special:latest, special:favorites. Empty for the root.

search_library.name: Search library
search_library.description: Searches the library and returns the matching items.
